decisions.reason: Removing navigation from the website header and placing links in the footer does not alter the requirement to use shared headers and footers across webpages.
The navigation-location decision does not change cross-page responsive guidance or breakpoint behavior.
The source concerns website header navigation and the website footer, not the separate SaaS console shell header, side navigation, or footer.
Moving site navigation links from the header to the footer does not change whether previously supplied follow-on copy belongs on the landing page.
The source decision changes navigation placement, while the candidate's current visual-system attributes concern theme, typography, colors, and concept selection and remain valid unchanged.
The navigation-location decision does not change the How It Works section's position, presentation, or steps.
The source does not change the landing page's responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance.
The same message discusses sign-in branding separately, but the website navigation decision does not change the Actia branding requirement.
Moving navigation links from the header to the footer does not alter the plain HTML, Tailwind CSS, or Astro usage decisions.
The source does not remove or modify the landing-page sign-up button or its action.
The website navigation placement decision is unrelated to the provisioning wizard's visual specification, orientations, or unresolved accent choice.
